posts.text:
Secrecy is probably the worst choice they could make.

Nobody will trust the US government.

Nobody will trust the US companies.

Nobody will be sure whether they count on the availability of US products.

US startups may not get a fair shake.

The race towards sovereign models everywhere else will accelerate.
